title: HECM Draw Ceiling: Filing the Largest Accepted Line-of-Credit Draw Request
content:
When a borrower of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) asks to draw the most the line allows, the borrower's own draw request is filed for the draw ceiling, the largest line-of-credit draw request Cedarline accepts on the handling date.

## When the draw ceiling is worked out

The draw ceiling is worked out only once no payout plan change request on file for the loan still shows request status submitted. The draw ceiling is not worked out until every check draw on the loan whose draw request shows request status withdrawn carries its return entry.

Put the other way round: while any payout plan change request on the loan still shows request status submitted, or while any check draw whose draw request shows request status withdrawn lacks its return entry, the draw ceiling is not yet worked out.

## Limits on the request

The draw amount must be at least the plan's smallest draw, otherwise the request is declined with the reason below minimum draw, and may not exceed the loan's available line on the handling date, otherwise it is declined with the reason insufficient available line; funds held in any set-aside are never part of the available line and are never released through a draw. A draw request sized at the draw ceiling, and only such a request, may in addition not exceed the draw ceiling on the handling date, otherwise it is declined with the reason insufficient available line. Every other clause of the base draw rule stays in force for the draw that follows the request.

## Filing the request: `submit_line_draw_request_b0795434`

This is a borrower-owned action: the agent unlocks `submit_line_draw_request_b0795434` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call files one new draw request on the borrower's HECM loan through the Cedarline servicing portal for the stated amount and disbursement method, dated today and waiting for processing. Nothing is disbursed, and neither the available line nor the loan balance changes.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `hecm_loan_id` | Reference number of the borrower's HECM loan, as returned by the HECM loan lookup for that borrower. |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the borrower filing the request, as returned by the customer profile lookup. |
| `requested_amount` | The draw amount requested, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |
| `disbursement_method` | Exactly one of `ach` (direct deposit to the borrower's bank account on file), `wire` (same-day bank wire to the account on file), `check` (paper check mailed to the mailing address on file), `not_applicable` (no funds to send; applies only to requests that are not draws, so never the right value for a draw request). |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence giving the new draw request reference (beginning "hrq_"), the loan reference, the requested amount with 2 decimals, the disbursement method, the channel servicing portal, the request date (today) and the status submitted. A sentence containing "Draw request submitted" means the request is on file; afterwards the borrower can quote the reference, and the request shows as submitted until it is processed or declined.
